approval.reason: Bootstrap r1 baseline for Galaxy S22 Ultra ko-KR. Water Leak and Motion Sensor battery announcements were manually verified as correct TalkBack behavior. The Home Monitor Settings control remains an accepted known limitation because only the generic role is announced. Clothing Care diagnostics are acknowledged separately as non-blocking automation-engine diagnostics.

automation_acknowledgments.comment: Known traversal termination/recovery diagnostic. Accepted as a non-blocking automation-engine diagnostic for this bootstrap baseline. Not classified as an independent application accessibility limitation.

known_limitation_snapshot.description: Home Monitor Settings control exposes no meaningful accessible name and TalkBack announces only the generic role "Button".
known_limitation_snapshot.impact: Users cannot identify the purpose of the control from TalkBack speech alone.

structured_limitations.comment: Manually verified on the target device. TalkBack correctly announces the battery percentage. The missing automated speech was caused by the current TTS observation limitation.
